svg.title: What FlowCellar reads, what its library holds and what you look at
svg.desc: On the left the files a laboratory already has: MinKNOW run folders, which are all that is needed, and seven further kinds that each add sections. In the middle the command flowcellar scan, which only reads them. Then the library, one folder with a small file per run, the verdicts, an index, the pages and the configuration. On the right the pages: Home, Runs, Projects, Analyses, a page per run, Compare, flow cell history, one-file reports and PDF.
